title: Desk Guidance on Moving a Personal Sender Account Up a Verification Level
content:
An upgrade moves a Personal Sender Account up to a higher verification level and is applied only while the account status is active.

## Who applies it

- A support agent applies an upgrade at the customer's request when the target level does not require a compliance limit review for entry and every entry requirement of the target level is met in the records.
- When the target level requires a compliance limit review for entry (Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier, Paloma Private Client), the upgrade is applied only by an approved limit review decision for exactly that level and never directly by an agent.

## Entry requirements read from the records

| Requirement | When it is met |
|---|---|
| Documents | Every document the target level requires has a latest review of accepted and is unexpired on the upgrade date. A bank statement requirement of a number of months means that many accepted bank statement documents. |
| Account age | The upgrade may be applied only once the target level's minimum account age in calendar days has passed since the account was opened. Account age is counted in calendar days from the opened date, so the earliest qualifying date is the opened date plus that number of days. |
| Completed transfers | The account's completed personal transfers must be at least the target level's minimum. A completed transfer is a Bank Deposit transfer that is deposited, a Cash Pickup transfer that is paid out, or a Mobile Wallet transfer that is credited, on this account, counted over all time. |

**Account age at the boundary (hypothetical dates).** For Paloma Verified Plus, whose minimum account age is 30 calendar days, an account opened on 1 June first qualifies on 1 July (1 June plus 30 days); on 30 June it does not yet qualify.

## Which level is applied

When several levels qualify, the agent applies the highest qualifying level that does not require a compliance limit review; a level that requires review is never passed over. Hypothetical case: an account at Paloma Starter that meets every entry requirement of both Paloma Verified and Paloma Verified Plus is moved up to Paloma Verified Plus.

## Effect of the upgrade

The new sending limits, funding methods and service entitlements (support and statement entitlements included) take effect on the date the new level took effect, which is the upgrade date. An upgrade never refunds, re-prices or re-releases transfers already booked.

**Retired clause.** The clause under which the next periodic review due date was reset to the upgrade date plus the new level's periodic review interval in calendar months (empty when that interval is 0) is no longer in force. The next periodic review of an upgraded account is now set on the current basis for the refresh interval of an upgraded account.

superseded_clauses: next_review_due_date is reset to the upgrade date plus the new level's periodic_review_interval_months calendar months (empty when 0)
